headline: The project and security gates are now free lite versions, with the full versions in Opskeep Pro.
highlights: Project Gate, Elliot Design and Elliot Review stay free as lite versions: a problem-first project brief, a starter security record from a 12-point checklist, and a quick read-only security scan.

The full versions (the visual design workshop and approval dashboard, the machine-checked security baseline with CI enforcement, and full security reviews with a dashboard) are now in Opskeep Pro. Request access at princecaleb.dev.
If you rely on the full gates, do not run this update yet: updating replaces them with the lite versions. Install Opskeep Pro after updating to keep them.

verticals.update: git -C <clone folder> pull, then copy verticals/<pack>/skills/* into the agent's skills folder again
